user.title: Task Reminder
user.description: Which notify services reach you. Phone services get the reminder first; Alexa joins from the second reminder, other devices from the third.

data_description.quiet_start: Non time-critical reminders wait until the quiet hours end. Same start and end turns quiet hours off.
data_description.pause_players: Whatever is playing on them is paused when a reminder reaches the other devices, and resumed when the task ends.
data_description.tap_url: Optional dashboard path such as /lovelace/reminders. Empty opens Home Assistant at its default page.
data_description.notification_sound: Pick a sound, or type the exact file name of one you imported in the Companion app (with extension). iOS system sounds (.caf) must first be imported once: in the app, Settings, Companion App, Notifications, Sounds, System tab, Import system sounds, then restart the phone. Empty uses the default sound. Critical alerts use it too.
data_description.turn_off_players: Typically your TV. When a reminder keeps going (snoozes used up and the second keeps-going reminder is sent), these are turned off if still on. Never while silencing is active.
data_description.ring_seconds: For tasks and reminders that ring: how often the sound is triggered again, about the length of your sound plus a second or two (an iPhone plays at most 30 seconds of a custom sound).
data_description.ring_minutes: One reminder stops ringing after this long; the next regular reminder rings again.
data_description.ring_swap_seconds: Added to the ring interval for the second and later repeats: sending the new notification and removing the old one takes a moment, so those sounds would start too early. About 1.5; adjust until the repeats follow the sound without a gap or overlap.
data_description.room_provider: An entity whose state is the id of the area you are in (from your presence system). It decides which Alexa speaks first (the speakers in that area), which lights flash when a reminder keeps going (the lights of that area), and whether the TV is worth turning off (you are in its area, or it is playing). If it is not set, unknown or unavailable, or names no area, your place is unknown: every Alexa announces, no lights flash, and any TV that is on is turned off.
data_description.alexa_speakers: Your Echo speakers (Alexa Media Player). Put each one in its area in Home Assistant: the speaker in the area you are in announces first, the others join when a reminder reaches everyone. No naming rules, the area is all that matters.

data_description.dismissable: Can be ended without doing it (e.g. the bin is not full). Otherwise only completing it ends it.
data_description.duration_minutes: Leave empty when the task becomes due another way.
data_description.snooze_minutes: Comma separated, getting shorter, e.g. 10, 5, 3. After the last one the reminder keeps going.
data_description.done_entity: Only counts once the task is due, so a door opened too early does not complete it.
data_description.done_then_entity: For a door sequence (back door, then porch door): the done entity must change first, then this one within the time window.
data_description.flag_entity: E.g. an input_boolean "bin has waste". Flag off makes the task dismissable with lighter escalation; completing it turns the flag off.
data_description.quiet_without_flag: With the flag off, send one passive notification and end the task instead of reminding.
data_description.schedule_entity: An afvalbeheer sensor (uses its Days_until and Sort_date attributes). The task starts once per collection and ends as expired when the collection has passed.
data_description.start_days_before: 1 = the day before. With "Due at time of day" the first reminder comes at that time on the start day (e.g. 18:00 the evening before); the task is already waiting in the panel before that.
data_description.collection_end_time: Optional. On collection day the task ends at this time (e.g. 08:00): the bins are gone, so no more reminders. Empty: it ends when the schedule sensor moves on to the next collection.
data_description.start_tag: A tag from the Tags page in Settings. If the start and done tag are the same, scanning toggles: start when idle, done when running.
data_description.done_tag: A scan always completes the task, even before it is due.
data_description.good_moment_entities: Binary sensors (e.g. stairwell motion). While a reminder is unanswered, one of them turning on brings the next reminder forward.
data_description.sound: Overrides the sound set in the integration settings, for example a different one for the washer. Same choices; system sounds need the one-time import in the Companion app.
data_description.ring: Keeps triggering the sound on the phone until you snooze, complete or dismiss it, like an alarm. Each trigger is a new notification and the previous one is removed right after it. When the reminder is a critical alert (the keeps-going stage), the triggers are critical alerts too, and those may pile up in the notification list.
data_description.ring_seconds: Empty uses the interval from the integration settings. Set it to about the length of this task's sound.

error.invalid_minutes: Use whole minutes separated by commas, e.g. 10, 5, 3.
error.duration_and_time: Choose either a duration or a time of day, not both.
error.invalid_name: Give the task type a name.
error.already_exists: A task type with this name already exists.
error.reserved_name: That name is used by the built-in ad hoc reminders. Choose another.

start.name: Start task
start.description: Starts a task of a type. Single-instance types return the running task.

due_in.name: Due in
due_in.description: Overrides when the task becomes due.

due_at.name: Due at
due_at.description: Overrides when the task becomes due.

done.name: Complete task
done.description: Completes tasks, by id or by type.

type.name: Type
type.description: All running tasks of this type.

snooze.name: Snooze task
snooze.description: Snoozes by the next, shorter, snooze period. Fails when none are left.

type.name: Type
type.description: All running tasks of this type.

dismiss.name: Dismiss task
dismiss.description: Ends a dismissable task without doing it.

type.name: Type
type.description: All running tasks of this type.

silence.name: Silence reminders
silence.description: Silence with a mandatory end time, or switch silencing off.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Off, no critical alerts, or silent (nothing sent; tasks pile up).

until.name: Until
until.description: When silencing ends. Required unless the mode is off.

remind.name: Remind me
remind.description: Starts a reminder or timer without any setup, e.g. an egg timer or "call the plumber at 15:00". Without a due time it is due immediately. Returns the task id.

message.name: Message
message.description: Reminder text. Defaults to the title followed by "is due".

due_at.name: Due at
due_at.description: Due at this date and time.

time_critical.name: Time critical
time_critical.description: May break quiet hours. On by default, since you asked for this moment.

dismissable.name: Dismissable
dismissable.description: Can be ended with Dismiss as well as Done. Off by default: for a reminder Done already ends it.

ring.name: Ring
ring.description: Keep triggering the sound until you answer, like an alarm. On by default for reminders and timers.

no_notify_services.title: Task Reminder has no notify services
no_notify_services.description: No phone, Alexa or other device notify service is configured, so reminders are not delivered. Open the Task Reminder integration, choose Configure and select at least one notify service, for example your phone.

ring_budget.title: Ringing stopped to save the daily notification limit
ring_budget.description: The Companion app allows 500 notifications a day per device and {count} have been sent today, so ringing was stopped until midnight UTC. Regular reminders still arrive. Increase the ring interval or shorten the ring time in the integration settings.
